title: Remove Join Messages
body:
🚀 JoinHider | Lightweight Join/Quit Manager
JoinHider is a high-performance, ultra-lightweight plugin designed to give you full control over the join and quit messages on your Minecraft server. Tired of chat clutter? This plugin is the surgical tool you need to keep your chat clean and professional.

✨ Features
100% Configurable: Change or completely disable join and quit messages.

Performance First: Zero lag. Written in optimized Java to ensure your TPS stays at 20.0.

Toggleable Messages: Want to hide messages for everyone? Or just set a custom one? It’s just one click away in the config.

Simple & Clean: No unnecessary "bloatware" features. It does one thing and does it perfectly.

⚙️ Configuration (Polish by Default)
The plugin comes with a Polish config.yml by default, but the structure is so intuitive that anyone can understand it! Even if you don't speak Polish, you can easily swap the text to English (or any other language) in seconds.
